svg.title: Country/economy paired GDP per capita growth differences, 1970 to 2021
svg.desc: 189 paired differences. Each point is mean growth during high resource rents minus mean growth during low resource rents for one country or economy. The mean difference is 0.973 percentage points.
svg.text: GDP per capita growth difference by economy, 1970–2021
High-rent mean minus low-rent mean; one paired difference per economy (n = 189)
Difference in mean annual growth (percentage points)
